description.p: Dimly controls your external monitor's real backlight from the desktop, so you can stop reaching for its buttons. It keeps the monitor in step with your laptop screen and dims both on a schedule, for long working days that are easier on your eyes.

ul.li: Brightness, contrast and warmth sliders, plus one-click Night, Evening, Day and Max presets that set all three, at levels you choose
Your laptop's brightness keys change the external monitors too
A top-bar menu, and keyboard shortcuts for brighter and dimmer
Switches preset by time of day, dimmer and warmer into the evening; a change you make yourself lasts until the next switch
Newly connected monitors join in automatically
Factory reset for monitors whose backlight has stopped dimming

description.p: Dimly talks to monitors over DDC/CI using ddcutil. Most desktop monitors support it, though some USB-C docks and adapters don't pass it through.

ul.li: Presets set brightness, contrast and warmth together, and can keep contrast or warmth as they are
Warmth also works where the desktop has no night light, such as older Linux Mint
The Linux Mint panel menu's warmth slider goes through the background service
A colour slider per monitor, for matching monitors of different makes
With several monitors, choose whether they move together or one by one
Keep the laptop screen a little brighter or dimmer than the monitors while in sync
Factory reset keeps the monitor's colour mode and colour gains
Warmth: one slider for less blue light on every screen, through the desktop's night light
The top-bar menu works on GNOME 45 to 50 (Ubuntu 24.04 to 26.04), not just GNOME 42
On Linux Mint, the menu is a Cinnamon panel applet
Choose where the menu sits: right, next to the clock, or left
The window shows what GNOME is doing with the menu, and the menu says when no adjustable monitor is connected
Top-bar menu with brightness, contrast and presets, so you don't need to open the window
The schedule runs inside the background service, with no periodic wake-ups
The window's contrast slider also follows changes made elsewhere
Many reliability fixes: no more lost or corrupted settings, sliders that stop working, or levels below 5% being pulled back up
Sliders follow brightness changes made with the shortcuts, the schedule or the laptop's keys while the window is open
Preset levels can be edited in the window
